messages:
marta (Marketing): Quick thread for Valora case study. Customer agreed to a 20-min zoom interview next Thu 9:30am PT. Need signed release + final quote before we push the blog + webinar teaser. Can we coordinate?
lucas (Sales): Great. I'll confirm speaker and ask them for a short metric we can use publicly. they mentioned a reduction in inference latency and cost after switching.
jiang (Legal): Checklist: signed release, logo usage permission, no active NDA that blocks publishing, and any required attribution language. If they edit the quote, please paste redlines here. I can review within 12 hrs of receiving assets.
marta (Marketing): I'll send release now. Planning to ask for a 1-line quote and one anonymized metric. ETA Tue EOD for assets.
dev (Design): For the hero image, prefer a horizontal logo and a headshot for the interviewee. Also need preferred hex for brand color if they share. I can whip up the social card once we have copy.
lucas (Sales): Note from customer: prefer we avoid vendor comparisons and sensitive throughput numbers. happy to share a relative improvement like "~1.8x lower inference cost for our prompt mix" and a caveat about long-seq latency.
jiang (Legal): "~1.8x lower inference cost for their prompt mix" is acceptable, but include a config/source note: "based on Redwood Inference with batching + KV cache on 8xA100 (internal test)", that wording protects us.
marta (Marketing): Draft quote I'll send them: "Redwood Inference cut our inference cost by ~1.8x across our typical prompts, letting us launch new features faster." sending to customer now and cc @jiang.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Valora interview 3 Thu 9:30am PT. Invites sent to customer + marta + lucas.
kelly (Ops): For routing: if publish leads come in, we should tag them to sdr-valora queue. I'll confirm the marketing->sales handoff in HubSpot by Thursday.
dev (Design): Quick Q: what length for the hero quote? 18 words or less fits the template.
lucas (Sales): Short is better. Also ask them for one sentence about "how they used the cost savings" (e.g., expanded feature X) so we can highlight outcome rather than raw numbers. anonymize if needed.
marta (Marketing): Will do. Also planning a webinar teaser email to go out Mon morning if we publish Friday. Need assets by Thur EOD for that timeline.
jiang (Legal): When you send the draft social copy, include the technical descriptor line. I'll pre-approve typical phrasing to speed customer signoff.
marta (Marketing): Copy. Will post customer-approved quote + logo here when they reply. :rocket:
